item.subject: science
item.stem: Priya sees a steel spoon, a freshly polished wooden bowl, a copper tumbler, and a clay pot on her grandmother's kitchen shelf in Madurai. The polished wooden bowl shines brightly. Which statement is correct?

options.A: The wooden bowl must be a metal because it shines brightly.
options.B: The bowl looks lustrous because of polishing, but its shine alone is not proof that it is a metal.
options.C: The bowl is non-lustrous, so it cannot be a metal.
options.D: Only clay pots can be polished to look shiny, so the bowl is a metal.
